candidate.purpose: Prequential delayed-label learning, online anomaly/drift detection and progressive validation for TAGX challenger scoring
candidate.layer: Online Learning / Drift Detection / Model Evaluation
candidate.maintenance: Release 0.26.1 prepared 2026-08-21; same-day CI/Python compatibility and release-runner fixes observed.
candidate.docsTests: README documents predict_one/learn_one prequential pattern, progressive validation, drift/anomaly detection; repository exposes active CI/docs.
candidate.securityNotes: No market credentials required for offline challenger use. Development builds may require Rust/Cargo; production hot path should pin wheels/version and avoid unnecessary extras.
candidate.lookAheadRisk: HIGH if learn_one receives same-session future outcomes; LOW only with reconciled delayed labels and immutable signal-time feature snapshots.
candidate.integrationPlan: Do not add production dependency. Prototype delayed-label prequential scoring offline after Final Snapshot Reconciliation; compare false-positive rate, Precision@20 and Time-to-Detection against the fixed TAGX score champion over >=3 complete sessions.

directFindingThisCycle.finding: Evaluation artifact reported Precision@20=0 and no hits while a displayed top-ranked candidate (WLDS) was itself annotated currentTop20=true. This is an evaluation-integrity contradiction, not a model result.
directFindingThisCycle.action: Patched evaluator to normalize ticker/symbol keys, fall back to canonical lastTop20Rank, use the actual Top-K denominator, and fail closed when candidate annotations disagree with benchmark membership.
